# FastFence documentation

Run `uv tool run --python 3.12 fastfence init`, then `uv tool run --python 3.12 fastfence serve`, with Ollama running. Initialization prepares Laya and the configured assessor; `init --config-only` skips component downloads. No FastFence checkout is required. Policies and identities are local; budgets and audit are process-local. Laya proposals require explicit review before activation.

- [Agent Communication Protocol](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/acp/): Protect real synchronous agent-to-agent ACP calls with shared input/output policies.
- [Custom Python text detectors](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/custom-detectors/): Add trusted literal and regex detect-secrets plugins at startup.
- [Public/private-key anonymization](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/asymmetric-anonymization/): Generate RSA keys and run authenticated stateless recovery envelopes.
- [Model upstreams](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/openai-upstream/): Connect Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible model server.
- [Getting started](https://fastfence.dev/dev/getting-started/): Install and start a local gateway.
- [Learn](https://fastfence.dev/dev/learn/): Follow small, runnable integration tasks.
- [Protected request example](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/protected-request/): Complete executable Python source for a protected model call.
- [Named Laya rule example](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/semantic-policy/): Version-aware actual-model preview and explicit activation.
- [MCP client example](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/mcp-client/): Authenticate and call a protected model through MCP.
- [FastMCP server example](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/fastmcp-server/): Register an actual FastMCP tool behind the control layer.
- [OpenAI client example](https://fastfence.dev/dev/examples/openai-client/): Use the standard SDK with the protected compatibility endpoint.
- [Policies](https://fastfence.dev/dev/policies/): Configure controls and publish reviewed changes.
- [Integrations](https://fastfence.dev/dev/integrations/): Connect Laya, REST, MCP and models.
- [Integration reference](https://fastfence.dev/dev/integration-reference/): Choose protocols, credentials and request paths.
- [HTTP API](https://fastfence.dev/dev/reference/http-api/): Endpoint inventory generated from Python source.
- [Settings](https://fastfence.dev/dev/settings/): Environment settings and defaults.
- [Architecture](https://fastfence.dev/dev/architecture/): Module boundaries, trust and runtime behavior.
- [Manual verification](https://fastfence.dev/dev/manual-testing/): Verify behavior on your own local installation.

- [Full documentation](https://fastfence.dev/dev/llms-full.txt)
